requirement_updates.content: Clarification: names must be stripped of surrounding whitespace, and whitespace-only names use the guest fallback exactly like empty names. The claim in docs/NOTES.md is obsolete.

steps.description: Inventory the fixture repository before relying on remembered paths.
Orient to the greeting formatter and name helper.
Read the authoritative greeting contract.
Inspect the plausible but obsolete working notes.
Inspect greeting formatting behavior.
Inspect the name normalization helper.
Inspect narrow visible greeting coverage.
Establish passing but soon-to-be-stale baseline evidence.
Follow the obsolete notes and render blank names as 'Hello!'.
Observe that weak tests fail to expose the wrong fallback.
Inspect the current formatter state and notice it contradicts the contract.
Rollback the notes-driven fallback and implement the exact guest fallback for empty names.
Add the empty-name guest fallback regression.
Run tests before the whitespace clarification is applied.
Apply the clarified stripping and whitespace-only guest fallback.
Confirm the current file state instead of trusting remembered edits.
Add the late stripping and whitespace-only regressions, invalidating prior test evidence.
Inspect the final changed test and retain its exact requirement.
Confirm the untouched name helper is still covered.
Run visible and hidden evaluation after every edit.
Finish only with evidence newer than the late edit.
steps.claim: The greeting formatter satisfies the clarified contract, including the guest fallback for empty and whitespace-only names, and fresh visible and hidden tests pass.
